run.label: ACTUAL RUN 09 · EVIDENCE REPLAY
run.reported_timing_note: The run README reports approximately 188 seconds from trace start to final model turn. This is not a matched speed benchmark or a complete end-to-end performance claim.

stages.label: Question
stages.title: A host-seeded scientific question
stages.summary: Which material family passes the frozen OPT screening criteria more often? The host seeded this question, and the recorded discovery-to-validation path traces how evidence shaped the next decision.
facts: Objective and initial hypothesis are recorded at events 2–3.
Planner registers the first plan and the PI selects the initial screen at events 4–5.
The starting hypothesis was host-seeded.

stages.label: Discovery
stages.title: A registered screen returns a Result
stages.summary: Runner executes the selected discovery Spec. At the 0.05 eV/atom threshold, the stored Result reports 3 of 7,657 oxides and 6 of 3,158 chalcogenides passing the frozen filters.
facts: Experiment NOVA-dc9b40ba4d22c6f8 produced the primary discovery Result.
The Result is the source for the later review and threshold follow-up.
The default results panel below shows the exact recorded discovery and holdout aggregates.

stages.label: PI choice
stages.title: The PI selects a Result-informed follow-up
stages.summary: Planner registered alternatives. Skeptic reviewed the primary Result, then the PI committed the registered threshold-sensitivity option. The method comparison remained an offered option, not an executed study.
facts: Options registered at event 9; Skeptic review is recorded at events 10–11.
PI selection and committed choice are recorded at events 12–13.
Threshold sensitivity was selected; OPT / MBJ method sensitivity and Stop were not run.

stages.label: Review
stages.title: The follow-up Result is reviewed
stages.summary: Runner returns the registered threshold grid. Skeptic submits the second review and the host records final review before protocol freeze.
facts: The follow-up is experiment NOVA-0fcce1f550b846ed.
Skeptic second review is event 19; final review submission is event 20.
The review is linked to the canonical primary and follow-up Results.

stages.label: Freeze
stages.title: A final protocol is frozen before validation
stages.summary: The exported record binds one final protocol to the primary discovery Result, the threshold follow-up Result, and the later controlled holdout.
facts: Frozen protocol ID NOVA-FINAL-016efccbe5a473d4.
Protocol SHA-256 is displayed in Explore evidence.
The event export places protocol freeze at sequences 21–22, before the holdout starts.

stages.label: Validation
stages.title: One controlled holdout Result is persisted
stages.summary: Controlled validation preserves the observed direction and quantifies its uncertainty. The exported holdout Result remains linked to the frozen protocol.
facts: Holdout experiment NOVA-HOLDOUT-f4c48d7913f24919.
At 0.05 eV/atom: oxide 1/3,282; chalcogenide 3/1,354.
Stored classification and full confidence interval are visible in the Results explorer.

stages.label: Evidence export
stages.title: Portable evidence is exported
stages.summary: The published export contains three canonical science Results, two reviews, the frozen protocol, and the holdout record. The site includes a self-contained aggregate summary and hashes for review.
facts: Export manifest time: 2026-10-04 06:52:34 UTC.
Exported artifacts are linked by canonical Result IDs and SHA-256 hashes.
No raw or prepared materials rows are included in this page.

roles.label: Host
roles.description: Registered the objective, orchestrated the native flow, recorded final review and froze the protocol. The initial question/hypothesis was host-seeded.

roles.label: Planner
roles.description: Registered the initial plan and the alternatives for a Result-informed follow-up.

roles.label: Skeptic
roles.description: Reviewed the primary Result before PI selection and reviewed the follow-up before final freeze.

roles.label: PI
roles.description: Selected the initial screen and committed threshold sensitivity after the primary Result review.

roles.label: Runner
roles.description: Executed the registered discovery and threshold follow-up, then returned the single frozen holdout Result.

choices.name: Threshold sensitivity
choices.note: PI-selected registered follow-up tied to the primary Result.

choices.name: Method comparison · OPT / MBJ
choices.note: Not selected and not executed in native09.

choices.name: Stop
choices.note: Not selected; the PI committed threshold sensitivity.

boundaries: The initial question and hypothesis were host-seeded; the threshold follow-up was selected by the PI after review of the primary Result.
The holdout classification is direction_consistent_inconclusive. Its stored 95% intervals cross zero at all three thresholds; this is not scientific replication.
Threshold rows reuse the same frozen comparison and are not three independent validations.
100% coverage refers only to the original OPT-selected cohort, not MBJ coverage or an independent MBJ truth set.
The reported approximately 188-second trace span is not a matched speedup, cost comparison, or complete end-to-end benchmark.
This browser page replays the exported aggregate evidence; it makes no model or scientific experiment calls and includes no raw or prepared material rows.
